title: 畅销缺货与滞销积压双向筛查
context: 销售＋库存联合分析：管理层要求以同一企业口径核对业务数据。
requirements: 2025年底仓库商品；近30日毛销量≥30且库存低于15日需求为畅销风险；近30日销量≤3且库存金额≥300000分为积压；仅有效商品。
commonError: 把门店库存与仓库库存混为一谈。
mysqlSql: WITH s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-12-02' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id), a AS (SELECT i.warehouse_id,i.product_id,i.quantity,i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents value_cents,COALESCE(s.sold,0) sold FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND p.active=1) SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,quantity,sold,value_cents,CASE WHEN sold>=30 AND quantity<sold*.5 THEN 'fast_shortage' ELSE 'slow_excess' END issue FROM a WHERE (sold>=30 AND quantity<sold*.5) OR (sold<=3 AND value_cents>=300000) ORDER BY issue,value_cents DESC,warehouse_id,product_id
